property_summary: C.transfer delegates transferFrom for every recipient and returns true only if all delegated calls succeed; it never returns false—it either returns true or reverts.
If c has no code at caddress, calling transfer reverts for every non-empty _tos list.
When caddress contains no code, a transfer with a single-element recipient list reverts.
If caddress is an EOA (no code) and the recipient list is non-empty, transfer always reverts, regardless of from, to, or v.
If the target address has no code, transfer reverts for any non-empty recipient list, regardless of the arguments.
When caddress has no code, transfer with one recipient always reverts, for any from, to, and v.
For any call with at least one target, transfer either reverts or every transferFrom call on the target contract succeeded, so the call cannot silently skip any target.
If transfer succeeds, it must return true; if it reverts, the revert flag captures it.
For any single-target call with a nonzero value, the call either reverts or returns true; it never returns false.
If transfer does not revert and the token contract address is not the zero address, then it must return true.
